meta.author: OpenMedia
meta.summary: Cleans up cookie banners, ads and app prompts on 9GAG
meta.notes: **Live check (2026-11-13).** Checked `https://9gag.com/` in logged-out desktop Chromium at 1512×862. Three Google ad iframes matched; two visible placements were in the viewport (300×250 and 300×600). `#didomi-host` existed but was hidden; no visible cookie or app banner was found. `recipes/fixtures/9gag/desktop-real.html` is a sanitized excerpt of one observed ad slot; dynamic ad contents are omitted. Cookie and app selectors remain generic and are not verified for this site.
